reason: My admin already types the receipts into Excel every week. It's behind, sure, but it gets done, and I'm not changing how the office works for another bot. Half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a receipt reader doesn't fix my real hole.
objection: $19 a month for something my admin already does, and I doubt it reads a crumpled Indonesian fuel receipt or a mechanic's scribble properly. If my admin has to check every row anyway, I'm paying twice.
would_change_my_mind: My admin runs the free 30 on a real week of our scooter parts and fuel receipts, it gets them right without fixing, and it saves her hours so she can stop doing the Friday catch-up.
